<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="avatarGoldie" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#B1B5C0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#858992"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1.2" stdDeviation="1.5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".08"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F2EB"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="24" y="32" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <g fill="#000000">
    <rect x="311" y="25" width="3" height="7" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="316" y="22" width="3" height="10" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="321" y="19" width="3" height="13" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="326" y="16" width="3" height="16" rx="1"/>
    <path d="M340 28 L344 24 L348 28" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M338 25 Q344 18 350 25" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M341 28 Q344 25 347 28" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="358" y="19" width="24" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="22" width="18" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="383" y="23" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="29,78 21,86 29,94" fill="none" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="21" y1="86" x2="38" y2="86" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="55" y="92" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Archived</text>
    <text x="348" y="91" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1DAB61">Edit</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Notice -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="16" y="119" width="358" height="76" rx="10" fill="#FEEECD"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="39" cy="145" r="12" fill="#1DAB61"/>
  <line x1="39" y1="139" x2="39" y2="148" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="152" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="62" y="143" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Archived chats stay out of your inbox.</text>
  <text x="62" y="165" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">They'll automatically unarchive when new messages arrive.</text>
  <polyline points="347,145 352,150 347,155" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Section heading -->
  <text x="21" y="226" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">ARCHIVED CHATS</text>

  <!-- Chat row shadow and surface -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="12" y="242" width="366" height="82" rx="10" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Avatar -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="283" r="28" fill="url(#avatarGoldie)" stroke="#0A0A0A1A" stroke-width=".5"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="274" r="8" fill="#F5F2EB" opacity=".9"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="294" rx="15" ry="10" fill="#F5F2EB" opacity=".9"/>
  <text x="52" y="288" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">GW</text>

  <!-- Chat content -->
  <text x="94" y="273" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Goldie Wilson</text>
  <text x="94" y="296" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6E6E6E">Hey! Are we still on for Saturday?</text>
  <text x="346" y="273" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6E6E6E">Yesterday</text>
  <circle cx="350" cy="298" r="9" fill="#1DAB61"/>
  <text x="350" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">2</text>
  <line x1="94" y1="313" x2="362" y2="313" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Archived action affordance -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="350" width="358" height="52" rx="10" fill="#0A0A0A08"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="376" r="13" fill="#1DAB61"/>
    <polyline points="37,376 41,380 49,371" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="68" y="382" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">New messages will return chats here</text>
    <polyline points="348,371 353,376 348,381" fill="none" stroke="#959394" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom tab bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="756" width="390" height="54" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="756" x2="390" y2="756" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Chats tab -->
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="763" width="55" height="28" rx="14" fill="#DFF4E8"/>
    <rect x="43" y="768" width="18" height="14" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="47,782 47,786 52,782" fill="#1DAB61"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="768" r="4" fill="#1DAB61"/>
    <text x="50" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#1DAB61">Chats</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Updates tab -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="124" cy="775" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="124" cy="775" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="124" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Updates</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Communities tab -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="197" cy="771" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="210" cy="773" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <ellipse cx="197" cy="782" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="210" cy="783" rx="7" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="202" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Communities</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Calls tab -->
  <g>
    <rect x="271" y="767" width="17" height="17" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="275" y1="771" x2="284" y2="780" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="284" y1="771" x2="275" y2="780" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="280" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Calls</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Settings tab -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="349" cy="775" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="775" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="349" y1="763" x2="349" y2="767" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="349" y1="783" x2="349" y2="787" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="775" x2="341" y2="775" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="357" y1="775" x2="361" y2="775" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="349" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Settings</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="137" y="826" width="116" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
